issues.detail: The Hebrew 'יְשַׁעְיָהוּ בֶן אָמוֹץ' means 'Isaiah son of Amoz' (a personal name, Amoz). The Chinese renders it as '以賽亞兒子亞摩斯城' which reads 'Isaiah son of Amoz city' — adding '城' (city) after '亞摩斯' (Amoz), making it appear that Amoz is a city rather than a personal name. This is an addition that changes the proper name's referent.
